bio: In front of the Canal Baussengue marina, a picturesque trattoria where waiters and clients call to each other in a cheerful and distinctly Italian atmosphere! Homemade fare (spaghetti, gnocchi etc), Parma prosciutto cut with the slicer, and the great Italian classics. The terrace is taken by storm in fine weather, as is the lunchtime chalkboard menu, excellent value for money.
